agent_explanation: Controller-driven body 1 converges exactly onto its final waypoint (x=7.13516..., y=9.59857...) with ~0 velocity by step 1227. At the next update the direction-to-waypoint vector has zero length; normalizing it (0/0) yields NaN which propagates to position, velocity, energy and work at step 1228, while other bodies stay finite. Adding tiny sensor noise prevents bit-exact zero distance and removes the NaN, confirming a waypoint-arrival divide-by-zero singularity.
